points.description: Names at least two sensible road features usable for categorising roads from the image, such as road width, road length (e.g. between junctions/dead ends), road colour, or edges (edge detection).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only one valid feature is given.

points.description: Gives further valid features or a use for them: more features from the list (width, length, colour, edges), or edges/shadows to tell bridges and flyovers apart, or length between junctions/dead ends.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if one more feature is given but vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for about three valid features in any wording, such as width, length, colour, edges or shadows. Give 1 mark for one or two valid features, or for vague but relevant ideas. Give 0 for unrelated answers. Wrong extra remarks do not lose marks.
